latex.misplaced_ampersand: Literal '&' used in text mode. Use '\&' for an ampersand, or enclose columns inside an alignment environment like 'tabular' or 'align'.
latex.undefined_control_sequence: LaTeX command or macro not recognized. Check for typos or verify the required package is imported in the preamble.
latex.undefined_environment: Environment '{{env}}' is not recognized. Verify spelling or import the LaTeX package that provides '\begin{{lb}}{{env}}{{rb}}'.
latex.undefined_environment_generic: Environment not recognized. Verify spelling or check that the providing package is imported in the preamble.
latex.missing_dollar: Math symbol used in text mode. Wrap formulas inside '$ ... $' for inline math or '\[ ... \]' for display math.
latex.extra_brace_or_dollar: Unbalanced delimiter or curly brace. Check that every '{' and '$' has a matching closing pair.
latex.mismatched_env: Mismatched environment closure: '\begin{{lb}}{{beginEnv}}{{rb}}' was closed with '\end{{lb}}{{endEnv}}{{rb}}'. Ensure tags match and are properly nested.
latex.mismatched_env_generic: Mismatched environment tags. Ensure each '\begin{...}' has a matching '\end{...}'.
latex.undefined_reference: Cross-reference key '{{key}}' not found. Ensure a matching '\label{{lb}}{{key}}{{rb}}' exists in your document.
latex.undefined_reference_generic: Cross-reference key not found. Ensure a matching '\label{...}' anchor exists in your document.
latex.undefined_citation: Citation key '{{key}}' not found. Check that the entry exists in your .bib file and matches case-sensitively.
latex.undefined_citation_generic: Citation key not found in bibliography (.bib). Verify case sensitivity and bibliography entry keys.
latex.font_not_found: Font '{{font}}' was not found by XeTeX. Ensure it is installed on your OS, or load the font by exact file name (e.g. '\setmainfont{{lb}}{{font}}.otf{{rb}}') if it resides in the project.
latex.font_not_found_generic: Font not found by XeTeX. Ensure the font is installed on your OS or specify the exact OpenType/TrueType filename.
latex.inputenc_ignored: Tectonic runs on XeTeX which natively supports UTF-8 Unicode. You can safely remove '\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}'.
latex.pagelabels_info: Informational notice from hyperref. Document outline and page labels will synchronize automatically on subsequent runs.
latex.option_clash: Package '{{pkg}}' was loaded multiple times with conflicting options. Declare options globally using '\PassOptionsToPackage{options}{{lb}}{{pkg}}{{rb}}' before \documentclass, or consolidate package imports.
latex.option_clash_generic: Package was loaded multiple times with conflicting options. Declare options globally using '\PassOptionsToPackage{options}{package}' before \documentclass.
latex.unknown_docclass_caption: Document class has custom caption formatting that may conflict with the 'caption' package. Configure styling with '\captionsetup' or suppress the notice with '\WarningFilter{caption}{Unknown document class}'.
latex.asset_not_found: Figure or asset '{{file}}' was not found. Verify the relative path matches your project directory structure.
latex.asset_not_found_generic: Figure or asset not found. Verify the relative path matches your project folder structure (e.g. 'figures/image.pdf').
latex.sty_not_found: LaTeX package '{{file}}' not found. Verify the package name or place '{{file}}' in your project folder.
latex.sty_not_found_generic: LaTeX package (.sty) not found in bundle or project. Verify required package name or place the '.sty' file in your project folder.
latex.cls_not_found: Document class '{{file}}' not found. Ensure '{{file}}' is present in your project root directory.
latex.cls_not_found_generic: Document class (.cls) file not found. Ensure the custom class file is present in your project directory.
latex.bib_not_found: Bibliography database '{{file}}' not found. Verify the file name and path in your project directory.
latex.bib_not_found_generic: Bibliography (.bib) file not found. Verify the file name matches your project folder structure.
latex.graphic_not_found: Graphic file '{{file}}' not found. Verify the file path matches your project folder structure.
latex.file_not_found: File '{{file}}' not found in bundle or project. Verify the file name and relative path.
latex.float_specifier: LaTeX float placement specifier '[h]' alone is too restrictive. Use '[htbp]' so LaTeX can position the float at the top or bottom of the column if it does not fit inline.
latex.usepackage_before_documentclass: All '\usepackage{...}' declarations must be placed in the preamble after '\documentclass{...}' and before '\begin{document}'.
latex.fallback_bibtex: Informational notice: BibLaTeX is using the embedded in-memory BibTeX backend without requiring external Biber.
latex.empty_bibliography: No matching entries found in .bib for this category or filter. Comment out this \printbibliography command if you have no publications of this type.

typst.font_not_found_linux: Font '{{font}}' is not installed on your Linux system. To install: '{{installCmd}}'. You can also use bundled fonts: 'Libertinus Serif' or 'New Computer Modern', or define a fallback: font: ("{{font}}", "Libertinus Serif").
typst.font_not_found_windows: Font '{{font}}' was not found on your Windows system. Download and install it in Settings > Personalization > Fonts (or right-click > 'Install for all users'). Alternatively, use 'Libertinus Serif' or define a fallback: font: ("{{font}}", "Libertinus Serif").
typst.font_not_found_macos: Font '{{font}}' was not found on macOS. Install it in Font Book or via Homebrew ('brew install --cask font-{{brewName}}'). Alternatively, use 'Libertinus Serif' or define a fallback: font: ("{{font}}", "Libertinus Serif").
typst.font_not_found_other: Font '{{font}}' is not available. Install it on your system or use the bundled font 'Libertinus Serif'.
typst.equation_numbering: To cross-reference equations with @label, enable equation numbering by adding: #set math.equation(numbering: "(1)") to your document.
typst.unknown_variable: Variable '{{name}}' is not defined. Check spelling or declare it with a #let statement: '#let {{name}} = ...'.
typst.unknown_variable_generic: Undefined variable. Check spelling or declare it with a #let statement.
typst.delimiter_mismatch: Unclosed or mismatched delimiter. Check matching parentheses (), brackets [], or braces {}.
typst.generic_syntax: Review Typst syntax or function arguments.

linter.unclosedEnv: Unclosed LaTeX environment: '\begin{{lb}}{{env}}{{rb}}' is missing a matching '\end{{lb}}{{env}}{{rb}}'.
linter.misplacedAmpersand: Misplaced alignment tab character '&'. Use '\&' for a literal ampersand or place inside an alignment environment ('align', 'tabular', 'pmatrix').
linter.undefinedRef: Undefined reference anchor: '\ref{{lb}}{{key}}{{rb}}'. No matching '\label{{lb}}{{key}}{{rb}}' found in document.
linter.unescapedUnderscore: Unescaped underscore '_' in text mode. In LaTeX this triggers '! Missing $ inserted'. Use '\_' for a literal underscore or wrap in math mode '$ ... $'.

latex.customMacroDocumentation: Custom command defined in workspace class (.cls) or style (.sty) file.

documentclass.documentation: Sets the document type (article, report, book, beamer).

usepackage.documentation: Loads a LaTeX package/extension into the preamble.

geometry.documentation: Configures paper size and page margins via the geometry package (e.g. margin=2.5cm, top=2cm, left=3cm).

hypersetup.documentation: Sets hyperlink styling and PDF metadata properties via the hyperref package.

graphicspath.documentation: Defines root directories where graphicx will search for image files.

setlength.documentation: Sets the value of a LaTeX length variable (e.g. \parindent, \parskip).

newcommand.documentation: Creates a new user-defined LaTeX command macro.

renewcommand.documentation: Overwrites an existing LaTeX command macro.

DeclareRobustCommand.documentation: Creates a robust macro that will not expand prematurely in moving arguments.

IEEEoverridecommandlockouts.documentation: Unlocks commands in IEEEtran to enable funding acknowledgments in title footnotes.

IEEEauthorblockN.documentation: Formats author names in IEEE conference title blocks.

IEEEauthorblockA.documentation: Formats author affiliation and email in IEEE conference title blocks.

title.documentation: Sets the main title of the document.

author.documentation: Sets the author(s) of the document.

date.documentation: Sets the date (use \today for current date).

today.documentation: Outputs the current date dynamically (e.g. March 15, 2026).

maketitle.documentation: Typesets the title, author, and date block.

listoffigures.documentation: Generates an automated list of floating figures.

listoftables.documentation: Generates an automated list of floating tables.

appendix.documentation: Changes section numbering to letters (A, B, C...) for appendixes.

pagenumbering.documentation: Sets page numbering format (arabic, roman, Roman, alph, Alph).

setcounter.documentation: Assigns a numeric value to a counter.

addtocounter.documentation: Increments a counter by a given integer.

newpage.documentation: Forces a break to a new page.

clearpage.documentation: Forces a page break and outputs all pending floating figures/tables.

scriptsize.documentation: Switches font size to script size (for sub/superscripts).

footnotesize.documentation: Switches font size to footnote size.

small.documentation: Switches font size to small (commonly used for abstracts and author affiliations).

normalsize.documentation: Resets font size to the document default base size.

LARGE.documentation: Switches font size to extra large.

Huge.documentation: Switches font size to the largest available size.

textbf.documentation: Applies bold font weight to the text enclosed in braces.

textit.documentation: Applies italic (oblique) font shape to the text.

texttt.documentation: Applies fixed-width font suited for inline code, filenames, or variables.

emph.documentation: Emphasizes text by italicizing normal text or uprighting already italicized text.

textsc.documentation: Formats text in small capital letters.

text.documentation: Embeds normal text font inside mathematical equations (amsmath).

textcolor.documentation: Sets the foreground color of text (xcolor package).

colorbox.documentation: Places text on a colored background box.

textbackslash.documentation: Produces a literal backslash in text mode.

textsuperscript.documentation: Formats text as a superscript in text mode (e.g. for author affiliations).

textsubscript.documentation: Formats text as a subscript in text mode.

textdaggerdbl.documentation: Produces a double dagger symbol in text mode (commonly used for author footnotes).

textdagger.documentation: Produces a dagger symbol in text mode.

textwidth.documentation: The width of the text body on the page.

linewidth.documentation: The current line width within the active environment or column.

columnwidth.documentation: The width of a single column in multi-column layout.

makecell.documentation: Enables manual line breaks and aligned content inside tabular cells (makecell package).

centering.documentation: Centers content within the current environment or scope.

raggedright.documentation: Aligns text to the left margin without right-side justification.

raggedleft.documentation: Aligns text to the right margin.

item.documentation: Adds a bullet or numbered entry inside itemize or enumerate environments.

item_opt.documentation: Adds an item with a custom label (e.g. for description lists).

section.documentation: Creates a top-level numbered section heading.

subsection.documentation: Creates a second-level numbered subsection heading.

subsubsection.documentation: Creates a third-level numbered subsubsection heading.

paragraph.documentation: Creates an unnumbered bold inline paragraph heading.

includegraphics.documentation: Embeds an image file into the document (graphicx package).

caption.documentation: Sets the descriptive caption for a floating figure or table.

toprule.documentation: Adds a professional top rule inside a tabular environment (booktabs).

midrule.documentation: Adds a professional rule between table header and body (booktabs).

bottomrule.documentation: Adds a professional bottom rule inside a tabular environment (booktabs).

textasciicircum.documentation: Prints a literal caret character in text mode.

textasciitilde.documentation: Prints a literal tilde character in text mode.

vspace.documentation: Inserts vertical whitespace of the specified dimension.

hspace.documentation: Inserts horizontal whitespace of the specified dimension.

hfill.documentation: Expands horizontally to push content to the margins.

vfill.documentation: Expands vertically to push content to the bottom of the page.

quad.documentation: Inserts horizontal space equal to the current font size.

qquad.documentation: Inserts double horizontal space equal to 2em.

frac.documentation: Inserts a fraction with numerator and denominator.

sqrt.documentation: Inserts a square root, or n-th root with \sqrt[n]{x}.

sum.documentation: Inserts the summation symbol with lower and upper limits.

int.documentation: Inserts an integral with lower and upper bounds and differential.

oint.documentation: Inserts a closed curve line integral.

prod.documentation: Inserts the product sequence operator with limits.

lim.documentation: Inserts a limit with variable approach target.

nabla.documentation: Vector differential operator for gradient, divergence, and curl.

vec.documentation: Places a vector arrow over the symbol (e.g. \vec{v}).

hat.documentation: Places a caret (circumflex) hat over the symbol.

bar.documentation: Places a horizontal bar over the symbol.

tilde.documentation: Places a tilde over the symbol.

dot.documentation: Places a single dot over the symbol (Newtonian time derivative).

ddot.documentation: Places two dots over the symbol.

overline.documentation: Draws a continuous horizontal line above the entire expression.

boxed.documentation: Encloses a formula inside a rectangular bounding box (amsmath).

overbrace.documentation: Draws a curly brace above an expression with an annotation.

underbrace.documentation: Draws a curly brace below an expression with an annotation.

left_paren.documentation: Encloses math in parentheses that scale automatically to the enclosed height.

left_bracket.documentation: Encloses math in brackets that scale automatically to the enclosed height.

left_brace.documentation: Encloses math in curly braces that scale automatically to the enclosed height.

left_bar.documentation: Encloses math in single vertical bars for absolute value / determinant.

left_double_bar.documentation: Encloses math in double vertical bars for vector/matrix norm.

dots.documentation: Ellipsis dots placed along the baseline.

cdots.documentation: Ellipsis dots placed centered between operators (e.g. 1 + 2 + \cdots + n).

ddots.documentation: Diagonal ellipsis dots for matrix diagonals.

Delta.documentation: Greek uppercase letter Delta (Laplacian or difference).

lambda.documentation: Greek lowercase letter lambda (wavelength or eigenvalue).

mu.documentation: Greek lowercase letter mu (micro or mean).

rho.documentation: Greek lowercase letter rho (density or resistivity).

sigma.documentation: Greek lowercase letter sigma (standard deviation or stress).

Sigma.documentation: Greek uppercase letter Sigma (summation or covariance).

tau.documentation: Greek lowercase letter tau (torque or time constant).

leq.documentation: Order relation less than or equal.

geq.documentation: Order relation greater than or equal.

exists.documentation: There exists at least one element.

mathbb.documentation: Number sets in blackboard bold font.

mathcal.documentation: Calligraphic font for operators and spaces.

label.documentation: Assigns a unique key to refer to equations, figures, tables, or sections.

ref.documentation: Inserts the numbered reference for the given label.

eqref.documentation: Inserts equation reference enclosed in parentheses, e.g. (1).

cite.documentation: Inserts a citation corresponding to a BibTeX bibliography entry.

bibliographystyle.documentation: Sets the formatting style for references (plain, unsrt, alpha, abbrv, ieeetr).

bibliography.documentation: Loads bibliography data from a .bib file.

footnote.documentation: Inserts an automatically numbered footnote at the bottom of the page.

url.documentation: Typesets a raw URL as a clickable link (hyperref package).

href.documentation: Creates a hyperlink with custom anchor text (hyperref package).

makeheaders.documentation: Typesets left and right CV header blocks with alignment option (c, l, r).

makerubric.documentation: Includes and typesets a modular CV section/rubric file (CurVe class).

photo.documentation: Inserts a portrait photo with position option (l, r) in CurVe headers.

photoscale.documentation: Sets the scaling multiplier for the CV portrait photograph.

entry_star.documentation: Adds a key-aligned timeline entry item in CurVe rubric environments.

justifying.documentation: Enforces full paragraph justification with hyphenation (ragged2e package).

faGlobe.documentation: Renders a globe / web URL icon (fontawesome5).

simpleicon.documentation: Renders a brand icon by name from the embedded SimpleIcons suite (e.g. \simpleicon{x}, \simpleicon{python}).

setmainfont.documentation: Configures the primary document serif font for XeLaTeX/LuaLaTeX (fontspec package).

setsansfont.documentation: Configures the document sans-serif font for XeLaTeX/LuaLaTeX (fontspec package).

setmonofont.documentation: Configures the document monospace typewriter font for XeLaTeX/LuaLaTeX (fontspec package).

newfontfamily.documentation: Defines a new font-switching command for a specific typeface (fontspec package).

defaultfontfeatures.documentation: Applies default OpenType/AAT font options to subsequent font declarations (fontspec package).

addfontfeatures.documentation: Modifies OpenType/AAT features for the currently active font (fontspec package).

pagestyle.documentation: Sets the active page style (plain, empty, headings, myheadings, or fancy).

fancyhf.documentation: Clears or sets header and footer fields simultaneously (fancyhdr package).

fancyhead.documentation: Configures header content for specified page positions and odd/even pages (fancyhdr).

fancyfoot.documentation: Configures footer content for specified page positions and odd/even pages (fancyhdr).

lhead.documentation: Sets the left-aligned header text (fancyhdr package).

chead.documentation: Sets the centered header text (fancyhdr package).

rhead.documentation: Sets the right-aligned header text (fancyhdr package).

lfoot.documentation: Sets the left-aligned footer text (fancyhdr package).

cfoot.documentation: Sets the centered footer text (fancyhdr package).

rfoot.documentation: Sets the right-aligned footer text (fancyhdr package).

headrulewidth.documentation: Length macro controlling the thickness of the horizontal rule below the header (fancyhdr).

footrulewidth.documentation: Length macro controlling the thickness of the horizontal rule above the footer (fancyhdr).

fancypagestyle.documentation: Defines or redefines a named page style with custom fancyhdr settings.

titleformat.documentation: Customizes typography, numbering, and layout of sectioning commands (titlesec package).

titlespacing.documentation: Adjusts left margin, before-spacing, and after-spacing of section headings (titlesec).

titlerule.documentation: Draws a horizontal rule spanning the text width inside a section title (titlesec package).

titlelabel.documentation: Redefines the formatting of section numbers in headings (titlesec package).

urlstyle.documentation: Sets the font style used by \url and \href (tt, rm, sf, or same; url/hyperref).

newcolumntype.documentation: Registers a custom column specifier for tabular and tabularx environments (array package).

arraybackslash.documentation: Restores the meaning of \\ as a table row separator after \raggedright or \centering (array).

tabcolsep.documentation: Half the horizontal spacing inserted between columns in tabular environments.

raisebox.documentation: Shifts content vertically relative to the baseline (accepts \height, \width, \depth, \totalheight).

height.documentation: Natural height above the baseline of the box being measured inside \raisebox or \makebox.

width.documentation: Natural horizontal width of the box being measured inside \raisebox, \makebox, or \parbox.

depth.documentation: Natural depth below the baseline of the box being measured inside \raisebox or \makebox.

totalheight.documentation: Sum of natural height and depth of the box being measured inside \raisebox or \makebox.

thepage.documentation: Expands to the formatted representation of the current page counter.

labelitemi.documentation: Macro controlling the bullet symbol used for top-level itemize lists.

color.documentation: Switches the current foreground text color for the active scope (xcolor package).

bfseries.documentation: Switches the active font series to bold within the current group.

textbullet.documentation: Produces a solid bullet symbol in text mode.

equation.documentation: Centered display mathematical equation with automatic numbering.

equation_star.documentation: Centered display mathematical equation without number (amsmath).

align.documentation: Multiline equations aligned by ampersands (&) with automatic numbering on each line.

align_star.documentation: Multiline equations aligned by ampersands without numbering.

figure.documentation: Floating container for figures and graphics with caption and label.

table.documentation: Floating container for tabular data with caption and label.

tabular.documentation: Table grid alignment with columns (l=left, c=center, r=right).

tabularx.documentation: Table environment spanning a target width with auto-expanding X columns (tabularx package).

longtable.documentation: Table environment that automatically breaks across multiple pages (longtable package).

itemize.documentation: Creates an unordered list with bullet points.

enumerate.documentation: Creates a sequential list with automatic numbering (1, 2, 3...).

description.documentation: List where each item starts with a bold defined term [term].

pmatrix.documentation: amsmath matrix enclosed in round parentheses.

bmatrix.documentation: amsmath matrix enclosed in square brackets.

matrix.documentation: amsmath matrix with no surrounding delimiters.

Bmatrix.documentation: amsmath matrix enclosed in curly braces.

vmatrix.documentation: amsmath matrix enclosed in single vertical bars.

Vmatrix.documentation: amsmath matrix enclosed in double vertical bars.

proof.documentation: Proof environment with end-of-proof QED square symbol (amsthm).

abstract.documentation: Synopsis / abstract section for academic articles.

set_page.detail: Configure document page dimensions and margins
set_page.documentation:
Configure page size, orientation, and margins.

Example:
`#set page(paper: "a4", margin: (x: 2.5cm, y: 2.5cm))`

set_text.detail: Configure default text typography and language
set_text.documentation: Configure default document font family, size, and hyphenation language.

set_par.detail: Configure paragraph justification and line spacing
set_par.documentation: Set paragraph alignment justification and line spacing (leading).

set_math_equation.documentation: Number math equations automatically for cross-referencing (@label).

set.documentation: Applies default styles or configuration to an element type throughout the document.

show.documentation: Customizes how elements of a certain type are displayed or rendered.

let.documentation: Binds a value or defines a reusable function in Typst.

import.documentation: Imports definitions, variables, or functions from another Typst module or package.

include.documentation: Includes another Typst file directly into the document structure.

for.documentation: Iterates over an array, dictionary, or range to generate content dynamically.

if.documentation: Conditionally renders content or evaluates expressions based on a boolean condition.

align.documentation: Aligns content along the horizontal and vertical axes (e.g. center, left, right).

table.documentation: Creates publication-ready tables with customizable column widths, fills, and strokes.

table_header.documentation: Marks table cells as a semantic header row, including Typst header behavior for repeated table headings.

table_hline.documentation: Adds a horizontal table rule at the selected row boundary.

grid.documentation: Lays out content in a responsive, multi-column grid with configurable gutter spacing.

figure.documentation: Creates a captioned, numbered figure (image, table, code) with automatic reference label.

image.documentation: Inserts an image file (PNG, JPEG, SVG) into the document flow.

text.documentation: Applies inline font formatting, weight, color (fill), tracking, or styling to text.

strong.documentation: Applies strong emphasis to a Typst content block.

rect.detail: Rectangle box with optional fill and border
rect.documentation: Draws a rectangle with customizable dimensions, fill color, and border radius.

circle.documentation: Draws a circle with specified radius and fill color.

line.documentation: Draws a line with specified length, angle, and stroke style.

block.documentation: Creates a block-level container with margins, padding (inset), fill, and borders.

box.documentation: Creates an inline container that flows alongside text without breaking lines.

v.documentation: Inserts vertical whitespace of a given length (pt, em, cm, etc.).

h.documentation: Inserts horizontal whitespace of a given length.

pad.documentation: Pads surrounding content with specified horizontal (x) and vertical (y) distances.

stack.documentation: Arranges multiple items horizontally or vertically with consistent spacing.

colbreak.documentation: Forces a break to the next column in a multi-column document.

pagebreak.documentation: Forces a page break to a new page.

heading.documentation: Creates a structural heading of specified level with optional reference anchor.

terms.documentation: Creates a definition list pairing terms with descriptions.

link.documentation: Creates a clickable hyperlink with custom display text.

quote.documentation: Inserts a block quote with optional author attribution.

footnote.documentation: Attaches a footnote reference at current position.

bibliography.documentation: Renders the bibliography section using BibTeX citations.

cite.documentation: Cites an entry defined in the bibliography source.

highlight.documentation: Highlights text with a colored background.

calc.documentation: Built-in mathematical calculations and numeric functions.

rgb.documentation: Creates a color from hex string or red, green, blue values.

lorem.documentation: Generates mock Latin prose of specified word count.
